messages:
anya: Anyone else getting auth 5xxs in eu-west1? Console 503 and API /v1/auth failing for hosted tenants.
oncall-infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-eu-west1-controlplane. Paging #infra-oncall.
sara: I'm on it. Can confirm console request logs show TLS handshakes timing out against control-plane-api-eu-west1.
mike: Data plane (inference clusters) still returning traffic. GPUs healthy per node exporter, but routing -> control-plane is erroring.
julian: Starting initial triage: checking k8s control-plane namespace.
sara: running: ```kubectl get pods -n control-plane -o wide --context=eu-west1
NAME                             READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
api-server-0                     1/1     Running   0          3d
proxy-gateway-0                  0/1     CrashLoop 5          6h
config-manager-0                 1/1     Running   0          3d
``` 
sara: proxy-gateway is crashlooping with `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` in logs.
mike: That aligns with auth failures. Are cert rotation jobs showing errors? @deploy-bot any recent cert rotate runs in eu-west1?
deploy-bot: cert-rotator job run at 2026-03-18T08:11:02Z returned non-zero exit (exit code 2) on eu-west1, job PID 4421. See /var/logs/rotator/rotator-4421.log
anya: Could be partially expired chain. If control plane can't validate tokens, routing will drop config rollouts and console auth.
julian: Quick mitigation: we should route control-plane API traffic to control-plane-failover in eu-central1 while we fix certs. I'm going to update routing policy to prefer eu-central1 for new sessions and allow sticky sessions to drain.
sara: Agreed. Also block automatic config-rollouts to eu-west1 to avoid bad manifests. Runbook step: set feature flag controlplane.failover=true.
mike: Note: cross-region traffic will add egress cost and ~30-50ms median latency for EU users. Call out cost impact in IC notes.
anya: Running: ```infra-router set-priority --service control-plane-api --region eu-central1 --weight 80``` 
(oncall-infra-bot): Router change applied, service weights: eu-central1=80, eu-west1=20. Propagation ~20s.
mike: I see traffic shifting in metrics: control-plane request success rate up from 55% -> 98% for routed requests.
sara: Working on cert fix. Found that our internal ACME client failed to include intermediate chain when writing secret to k8s. Patching rotator to concatenate chain and restart proxy-gateway.
julian: Patch uploaded. Rolling restart proxy-gateway pods in eu-west1.
sara: Restart complete, pods now: ```proxy-gateway-0 1/1 Running 0 restart``` Logs show proper chain served.
anya: Can someone verify console auth path now (token exchange + userinfo)?
mike: Verified: token exchange success, console response 200, no 503s. Embeds & generation unaffected.
julian: Rolling back routing weights to original. ```infra-router set-priority --service control-plane-api --region eu-west1 --weight 100``` 
oncall-infra-bot: Router change applied, service weights: eu-west1=100. 
anya: Marking incident as resolved in the channel. Root cause: cert rotator failed to write full chain on eu-west1, causing proxy to serve incomplete chain and fail TLS validation for some clients. Follow-up: postmortem and change to ensure rotator writes combined chain and add canary cert checks.
mike: Note for finance/ops: we had ~4 hours of elevated inter-region egress; estimate ~ $1.2k extra egress for the window. Will include in incident cost notes.
sara: Filing PR for rotator fix and adding a preflight check. I'll add the postmortem draft to the incident doc.
anya: Thanks all :heart: — closing thread.
